name: tx_stack
x87_stkflt_note: R2-H06: this program drives the x87 stack past its ends. QEMU implements no stack faults, so the differential masks fstat IE|SF|C1|C0|C2|C3 (0x4741 -- the #IS response has no QEMU counterpart; C1 is the direction bit and C0/C2/C3 are implementation-defined per SDM Vol.1 Table 8-4) and the st* QNaN-indefinite substitution. The behavior itself is gated architecturally by px87stk.
x87_stkflt_ranges_note: The masks are the EXACT measured divergence set of an unmasked compare vs the pinned-QEMU golden (47 records, n=0..46): the eight FSTP pops over FFREE'd slots fault at n=20..27 (fstat IE|SF; the faulted pop writes the QNaN indefinite into the popped physical slot, so st* diverges per record ONLY in the slots already substituted -- each entry's field list names exactly those registers), and n=28..35 are the resync refill (FNINIT + 8 pushes) rotating the three substituted physical slots until all eight are overwritten. Records n=36..46 (last refill push, eight valid pops, exit) compare with ZERO masks. Everything outside the listed records/fields -- fstat AND st0..st7 -- compares at full strength.
